name: Privilege change shortly after sign-in
purpose: Highlight accounts that sign in and quickly change privileges.
description: Sequence rule: successful authentication followed within 15 minutes by a privileged-group addition made by the same account. Approved automation accounts are excluded.

attack.justification: Not asserted: the sequence is suggestive, and legitimate administrators behave the same way.

playbook.what: {username} signed in and then changed privileged group membership within a few minutes.
playbook.why: Quick privilege changes after a fresh sign-in can mean a newly obtained account is being used to gain access.
playbook.howSure: Low. Administrators do this routinely. The sequence is a prompt to check, not evidence of compromise.
next: Confirm {username} is expected to perform administration.
Check where the sign-in came from.
Look for the same pattern on other hosts.
verify: The sequence is linked to an approved change, or access is reverted.
